increment: doc72 section 20.37, durable normalized proposal request before claim and Git work

history_client_verification.scope: After the claim writer was made explicit, repeated the CPU loss/recovery/gate case with actual HTTP-to-typed-MCP and Assistant status reads. This is already one of the 29 distinct upstream cases.

contracts.initial_refusal: Payload writer scan could not resolve a newly spread claim dictionary. The writer was changed to explicit fields; the guard and its opaque allowlist were not weakened.

retention.scope: Normalized exact proposal body, including defaults, expected generation, source/base IDs, patch/recipe/flag/critic and action ID. The claim request_hash binds its values.
retention.ordering: Strict durable request publication precedes proposal claim and Maintainer Git.
retention.indeterminate_write: Exact explicit retry re-publishes identical values durably; file existence alone does not certify parent publication.
retention.conflict: Different, malformed or oversized unclaimed body is preserved and refused, with a named run-relative source.
retention.discovery: Optional started-claim request_path; raw patch is not inlined in status. Legacy rows remain readable.
retention.authority: Retained or orphan request proves no admission, authoring completion, gate pass, advancement or resume. Interrupted claim still needs explicit operator recovery.

coverage: Native Windows private CPU upstream fixtures and simulated process/publication losses; not real power-loss durability, a whole resumed engine/UI chat acceptance or full CI.
remaining_open: Bounded authenticated HTTP/MCP retrieval of raw retained request
